candidates.description: This vector activates for Hindi conditional, temporal, and relative adverbs and conjunctions (such as 'when', 'then', and 'if').
This feature vector represents common prefixes and character combinations found in Hindi text.
This vector represents common Hindi consonant-vowel conjuncts and postpositions.
This feature vector activates on common sub-word tokens and consonant clusters in the Devanagari script used for Hindi.
This vector activates for various Hindi vowel matras (diacritics) and dependent vowel signs combined with a comma or punctuation mark.
These tokens represent common Devanagari vowel sign and consonant letter combinations used in Hindi script orthography.
This vector activates common Hindi words, grammatical suffixes, and conjunctions frequently occurring in natural text.
This feature vector activates on Hindi script characters and Devanagari sub-word tokens.
This vector represents common character sub-word sequences or inflectional suffixes in the Hindi language.
This vector represents subword fragments and characters commonly found in Hindi text written in the Devanagari script.
